page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a centred section heading ("SECT. VI.") between two paragraphs. Running head at top left, page number at top right, gathering signature and catchword at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: gio locus esse posse videatur, Iesuitæ ta-
men & sacrificuli, dum sibi quidlibet a-
nimo reservandi libertatem reservant,
magna vultus constantia præstare non
verentur. Ipsissimam enim illam clausulam,
quà verbis conceptis spondent se
omnia antedicta fideliter observaturos
juxta tenorem verborum à se prolatorum,
tione; intelligunt interim cum alia re-
servatione, sc. quam tibi dicam.
SECT. VI.
Habent tamen paratam sibi hanc de-
fensionem, quò se a perjurio liberent:
nempe ex oratione verbali & mentali unam
confici integram orationem compositam,
in quà totâ conjunctim acceptâ
nulla fit falsitas. Ut exempli gratia,
si sacrificulus verbis prolatis juret se non
esse sacrificulum; adjectione illa in animo
reservatâ, sed non enunciata, Ut
tibi dicam: oratio hæc tota, inquiunt,
ex verbali & mentali composita, si integre
sumatur, erit vera; sc. Non sum sacri-
ficulus ut tibi dicam. Nec videtur ratio
aliqua

page.notes: Long s was rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "Iesuitæ", "sacrificuli", "sc." for printed "fc."). The running head reads "Præleƈtio" with a ct ligature, rendered as "Prælectio". Printed "Iefuitæ" and "fententiam" were corrected only for long s. The printed "Ut" and "tibi dicam" are italic as in the scan. The "&" is written as & to keep the XML valid. The printed "Præleƈtio" ligature and the reading of "à" in "à se prolatorum" are the only doubtful points, and both are clear enough to copy.
